skill_name: Write an analysis about the difference between a linear and a curvilinear relationship.
workflow: In statistics, there are two types of relationships between two or more variables: linear and curvilinear. Linear relationships are characterized by a straight line and are found when there is a direct, proportional relationship between two variables. Curvilinear relationships, however, involve a curved line and occur when variables have an indirect, non-proportional relationship.
